title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting UPDATE still executes without the taken_over_at backstop — the guarded mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person is an unwired orphan
evidence: form_handler.gleam: `case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token) ... False -> ... case sql.update_reference_call_status(config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated)`. update_reference_call_status.sql: `WHERE id = $1 AND status = $5::reference_call_status` (no taken_over_at clause). mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql (guarded `AND taken_over_at IS NULL`) has ZERO call sites in server/src (only its own definition in sql.gleam:1869-1907).
detail: Round-mandate condition 1 fails: the executed transition is still status-only-guarded; take-over never changes status, so a take-over between read and UPDATE still matches and yanks the row into awaiting_correction. The webhook leg carries the backstop; the wrong-person leg does not.
recommended_fix: Wire mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person into apply_wrong_person's awaiting branch (or add AND taken_over_at IS NULL to the executed UPDATE); the read-time check alone does not close the race.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): the wrong-person race pin is vacuous — it calls the guarded SQL directly while the handler executes a different unguarded UPDATE, so an unwired backstop cannot turn it red
evidence: `let assert Ok(returned) = rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)` ... `rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call2)` — the test invokes the SQL function directly, never the POST route /reference/:token/wrong-person. The only wrong-person POST tests (wrong_person_route_exhausts_corrected_row_test:1080, the taken-over leg in take_over_queued_row_stops_the_cadence_and_audits_test:~1414) apply the take-over BEFORE the POST, exercising only the read-time stand-down, not the read-to-UPDATE race.
detail: Round-mandate condition 2 fails: the pin neutralizes nothing the handler actually runs; the handler's executed update_reference_call_status stays unguarded and green. Per the mandate, a vacuous race pin = the blocker stays open.
recommended_fix: Drive the real POST route with the take-over committed between the context lookup and the UPDATE (e.g., a hook/test seam in apply_wrong_person); removing the backstop must turn the test red.

title: mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql + its generated sql.gleam code ship as an orphan module — a guarded query nobody calls
evidence: mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql: `UPDATE reference_call SET status = 'awaiting_correction'::reference_call_status, ... WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'contact_initiated'::reference_call_status AND taken_over_at IS NULL`. grep across server/src for mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person/MarkAwaitingCorrectionWrongPerson returns only sql.gleam's own definition; no call site in form_handler.gleam, trigger.gleam, or webhooks.gleam.
detail: The guarded SQL exists solely as a pin target for a test that calls it directly; production executes the unguarded update_reference_call_status. Dead module plus a false sense of closure.
recommended_fix: Wire the query into apply_wrong_person (closes the blocker) or delete the file, its generated code, and the vacuous test.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): N14 Escape-to-close remains unreachable in the click-open flow — keydown handler is still on the menu div, a sibling of the ⋯ button that holds focus
evidence: `html.button([...event.on_click(msg.UserToggledRefcheckMenu(call.reference_call_id)), ...], [html.text("⋯")])` then `html.div([attribute("data-testid", "refcheck-menu-" <> slot), attribute("role", "menu"), // r2 (N14): Escape closes the menu (the confirm_modal pattern). event.on("keydown", menu_escape_decoder(...))` — the handler sits on the menu div (no tabindex, never focused); keydown on the focused ⋯ button bubbles through ancestors, not the sibling menu div.
detail: After clicking ⋯, focus stays on the button; Escape never reaches the menu div's listener. Escape only works once a menu item button holds focus (Tab/click). Unchanged from r3; the code comment even labels it r2-era.
recommended_fix: Attach the keydown decoder to the ⋯ button (Escape closes even while focused), or move focus/autofocus into the menu when it opens.

title: STILL PRESENT (r3): N17 substitution's returned reference_call_id is still decoded and still never consumed
evidence: reference_checks_api.gleam: `fn action_result_decoder() -> decode.Decoder(String) { use id <- decode.optional_field("reference_call_id", None, decode.optional(decode.string)) ... }` and client.gleam: `ApiReturnedRefcheckAction(call_id, action, result) -> ... case result { Ok(_) -> {` — the decoded id flows into `result` and is discarded by `Ok(_)`; the refetch carries state.
